name: Ebbs
kurzbeschreibung: Border town near the German border featuring the Kleinholz pilgrimage church and a shopping center right on the edge of Kufstein.
beschreibung:
Ebbs lies at 475 m above sea level in the district of Kufstein, directly on the Bavarian border and just a few kilometers west of the fortress town of Kufstein. With around 5,800 inhabitants, the market town is one of the larger ones in Unterinntal and combines rural Tiroler character with economic strength close to the border.

Situated at the foot of the Zahmen Kaisers, Ebbs offers quick access to the Kaisergebirge with hiking trails up to the Pyramidenspitze or to the managed Aschenbrenner-Hütte. The Kleinholz pilgrimage church, a late Baroque building from the 18th century, has attracted pilgrims for generations and is the spiritual center of the municipality. At the same time, a large shopping center borders directly on Ebbs – many Kufsteiner and Germans do their weekly shopping here, giving the municipality a distinctive mix of tranquility and everyday consumer life. Families appreciate the proximity to nature as well as the good infrastructure with kindergartens, primary school, and middle school right on site.

Culturally, Ebbs maintains old traditions such as Blochziehen and various club festivals. Culinarily, alongside classic inns with Tiroler cuisine, one also finds regional products – from local cheese to Most. Anyone who wants to avoid Kufstein and still live centrally is in the right place in Ebbs: quiet enough for relaxation, close enough to the city and mountains 🏘️
